ns2:section.sectionText: This course allows mentors of the AHS James Scholar program to become a guide and support system for their first year, James Scholar mentees. Mentors will demonstrate leadership, planning, and other skills to develop a positive relationship with a mentee. The course is broken into two semesters and it can be used as a James Scholar Project for both of those semesters.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Applied Health Sciences. Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to James Scholars Program students.
